name: DishNet MikroTik Control Plane
summary: Router registry, provisioning, HotSpot policy, vouchers, sessions and AAA publication for MikroTik estates.

notes: Domain A (Starlink/UCRM) is NOT a dependency. This plugin owns its own PostgreSQL schema and never reads or writes Domain A state.
The Admin Panel is a SEPARATE consumer and is not part of this package. It reaches the plugin only over the HTTP API declared below.

requires.postgresql_role: the plugin does not create its database. plugin/bin/bootstrap.sql creates an owner role with CREATEROLE and CREATEDB (not superuser, not BYPASSRLS) and an empty database owned by it.
requires.worker: bin/worker.php is a long-running process for the intent queue. The Admin read panel does not need it; provisioning does. Not bound.
requires.web_server: any server that serves panel/ as static files and routes /api/v1/admin/* to plugin/public/api.php. The API reads the raw REQUEST_URI path, so a prefix mount must be stripped before PHP sees it.

DNB_DSN.description: PDO DSN for the plugin's own PostgreSQL database.

DNB_TOKEN_PEPPER.description: HMAC pepper for auth tokens and activation tickets.

DNB_ADMINAPI_USER.description: Admin read role. Defaults to dnb_adminapi.

DN_ALLOW_REAL_BINDINGS.description: F6-B gate. Absent or not 'yes-f6b-authorized' means every hardware adapter stays simulated.

DNB_SECRET_KEY.description: Symmetric key for stored device credentials. SecretBox refuses to run without it, so every device-credential path fails closed while it is unset. The Admin read panel does not use it.

DNB_OWNER_USER.description: Schema owner. Install-time only; never serves a request. Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_OWNER_PASS.description: Schema owner. Install-time only; never serves a request. MUST be set: the migrations create this role with a password literal that is published in the repository.

DNB_APP_USER.description: Customer request role. Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_APP_PASS.description: Customer request role. MUST be set: the migrations create this role with a password literal that is published in the repository.

DNB_WORKER_USER.description: Intent worker role. Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_WORKER_PASS.description: Intent worker role. MUST be set: the migrations create this role with a password literal that is published in the repository.

DNB_ADMIN_USER.description: Legacy Admin role; carries migration 015 blanket grants. Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_ADMIN_PASS.description: Legacy Admin role; carries migration 015 blanket grants. MUST be set: the migrations create this role with a password literal that is published in the repository.

DNB_ADMINWRITE_USER.description: Admin write role: EXECUTE on seven functions, zero table privileges. Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_ADMINWRITE_PASS.description: Admin write role: EXECUTE on seven functions, zero table privileges. MUST be set: the migrations create this role with a password literal that is published in the repository.

DNB_RADIUS_USER.description: RADIUS accounting ingestion role. Defaults to the migration role name.

DNB_RADIUS_PASS.description: RADIUS accounting ingestion role. MUST be set: the migrations create this role with a password literal that is published in the repository.

DNB_INTERNAL_TOKEN.description: Shared secret for the internal RADIUS accounting route. Unset means that route admits nobody.

DNB_EXPOSE_OTP.description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Returns the OTP in API responses. plugin.php doctor treats this as a blocker outside a disposable environment.

DN_DEV_STAFF_IDENTITY.description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Binds the Admin panel to a fabricated staff identity. Staff authentication (W-4) is not built, so this is currently the only way the panel renders anything.

DNB_INSPECT_USER.description: TESTS ONLY. A BYPASSRLS fixture identity. Setting it in a deployment puts a row-level-security bypass into the runtime environment.

writes.reason: These paths EXIST and every one answers 501. They are declared so the capability matrix is complete and testable, not because anything is bound. Binding them needs the staff identity provider (W-4) first, otherwise an audit row has no actor to name. The write floor itself is built (migration 020) and used by nothing.

install.prerequisite: psql -U <superuser> -d postgres -v db=dnb -v owner=dnb -v owner_pass=<generated> -f plugin/bin/bootstrap.sql

removes: every mt_* table and function in the public schema
does_not_remove: the owner role created by bootstrap.sql

F6-B.meaning: Real MikroTik and real FreeRADIUS bindings. While closed, every hardware adapter is a simulator and says so.

admin-write.meaning: No state-changing Admin route exists. DenyAllIdentity is the production Admin identity binding.

portal.meaning: Guest voucher activation. Blocked on Decision 5 (gated) and the F-7 remediation design.

excludes: public/ (the customer API front controller, which nothing here serves)
